overview:
This 4 day Sossusvlei and Walvis Bay safari is a guided loop from Windhoek with 1 night near Sossusvlei, 1 night in Swakopmund and 1 night in Windhoek. It covers the Sossusvlei dunes, Deadvlei, the Walvis Bay lagoon and a choice of a dolphin and seal cruise or Sandwich Harbour. It runs all year, costs from USD 1,990 per adult and suits first-time visitors and short stays.

The trip travels by 4x4 safari vehicle with an English or bilingual driver guide, staying in 3-star and 4-star accommodation, and starts and ends at Hosea Kutako International Airport.

Why choose a 4 day Sossusvlei and Walvis Bay safari?

The 4 day Sossusvlei and Walvis Bay safari pairs Namibia's two big contrasts in a long weekend: the red dunes and white clay pans of the Namib Desert, then the cold Atlantic coast, where flamingos feed in the Walvis Bay lagoon and seals and dolphins follow the boats.

The route also shows you the country between them, from the Khomas Hochland highlands and the Spreetshoogte Pass to the desert stop at Solitaire, so even the drives are part of the sightseeing.

  • Short stays: desert and coast in 4 days, from the airport and back.
  • Photographers: dune light at Sossusvlei, Deadvlei and Sandwich Harbour.
  • Marine wildlife fans: Cape fur seals, dolphins and flamingos at Walvis Bay.

What to expect on the 4 day Sossusvlei and Walvis Bay safari

Day 1 starts with a meet-and-greet at Hosea Kutako International Airport, then a drive of about 370 km over the Kupferberg and Spreetshoogte passes onto the Namib plains, with dinner and the night at Le Mirage Desert Lodge near Sossusvlei.

Day 2 begins early in the Sossusvlei dunes and at Deadvlei, before a drive of about 370 km to the coast with a stop in Solitaire and flamingos on the Walvis Bay lagoons. You stay at the Atlantic Villa Guest House in Swakopmund.

On day 3 you choose the Dolphin and Seal Cruise or the Sandwich Harbour tour, both ending around midday, or leave early for a Bushmen walk in Usakos. You then drive about 360 km to The Weinberg Hotel in Windhoek. Day 4 offers a relaxed morning or a Windhoek city tour before your airport transfer.

Is 4 days enough for Sossusvlei and Walvis Bay?

Four days is enough to see the main sights of Sossusvlei and Walvis Bay, but each of the first three days includes a drive of about 360 to 370 km, partly on gravel. If you want a second desert night and a game drive, compare our 5 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour. Our best time to visit Namibia guide explains the seasons month by month.

What is included in this Namibia desert and coast safari?

The price includes the meet-and-greet, airport transfers, round-trip transport in a 4x4 safari vehicle, an English or bilingual driver guide, park entry and conservation fees, unlimited bottled water, and the activities on the itinerary, including Sossusvlei, the Sandwich Harbour tour and the Pink Salt Lake near Swakopmund. The trip facts list full board meals in 3-star and 4-star accommodation.

Not included are extra nights before or after the tour, premium drinks, tips, internet and phone, optional activities, departure tax, personal insurance, international flights and visas. Before you travel, read our ultimate Namibia safari guide and our list of first-time Namibia safari mistakes.

faq.q: When is the best time for the 4 day Sossusvlei and Walvis Bay safari?
faq.a: The 4 day Sossusvlei and Walvis Bay safari runs all year, and the trip page does not set a season. May to September is cooler for climbing the Sossusvlei dunes, while December to February is hot inland. The coast at Walvis Bay and Swakopmund stays mild, often with morning fog, so pack a warm layer for the boat cruise.

faq.q: What is included in the 4 day Sossusvlei and Walvis Bay safari?
faq.a: The 4 day Sossusvlei and Walvis Bay safari includes airport transfers, a 4x4 safari vehicle with an English or bilingual driver guide, park and conservation fees, bottled water and the listed activities, including Sossusvlei, Sandwich Harbour and the Pink Salt Lake. Flights, visas, insurance, tips, premium drinks, optional activities and extra nights are not included.

faq.q: Where do you stay on the 4 day Sossusvlei and Walvis Bay safari?
faq.a: On this Sossusvlei and Walvis Bay safari you stay 1 night at Le Mirage Desert Lodge near Sossusvlei, 1 night at the Atlantic Villa Guest House in Swakopmund and 1 night at The Weinberg Hotel in Windhoek. We confirm each property in your written quote, based on availability for your dates.

faq.q: Is the 4 day Sossusvlei and Walvis Bay safari suitable for families?
faq.a: Yes, families can join the Sossusvlei and Walvis Bay safari, and the dune climbs are optional. Children usually enjoy the seals and dolphins on the Walvis Bay cruise. The first three days each include a drive of about 360 to 370 km, so tell us your children's ages and we will plan stops to suit them.
